Data Analyst.description: Transforms data into actionable business intelligence, dashboards, and analytical reports.

AI/ML Engineer.description: Designs, trains, and deploys scalable machine learning and deep learning models.

Software Engineer.description: Architects robust software systems using sound algorithmic principles and design patterns.

Web Developer.description: Develops responsive client-side and server-connected modern web applications.

Java Developer.description: Builds high-throughput backend enterprise applications and microservices using Java.

Python Developer.description: Develops modular web applications, APIs, and automated data workflows with Python.

Data Scientist.description: Discovers patterns and develops predictive models from complex structured and unstructured data.

Frontend Developer.description: Specializes in crafting intuitive, accessible, and high-performance user interfaces.

Backend Developer.description: Engineers scalable database schemas, business logic, authentication, and REST APIs.

Full Stack Developer.description: Oversees complete software delivery across both client interfaces and server infrastructure.

skill_recommendations.Python: Strengthen Python core fundamentals (OOP, list comprehensions, data structures, and standard libraries).
skill_recommendations.SQL: Practice complex SQL queries (multi-table joins, subqueries, CTEs, and window functions).
skill_recommendations.Excel: Learn Excel for data analysis (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and conditional data modeling).
skill_recommendations.Power BI: Learn Power BI for dashboard creation, DAX calculations, and interactive business intelligence reporting.
skill_recommendations.Statistics: Strengthen statistics fundamentals (hypothesis testing, probability distributions, variance, and regression analysis).
skill_recommendations.Data Analytics: Master exploratory data analysis (EDA), data cleaning techniques, and visualization with Pandas and Seaborn.
skill_recommendations.Machine Learning: Study core ML algorithms (supervised and unsupervised learning, scikit-learn pipelines, and model evaluation metrics).
skill_recommendations.Deep Learning: Explore neural network architectures (CNNs, RNNs, Transformers) using PyTorch or TensorFlow.
skill_recommendations.Git: Learn Git version control workflow (branching, rebasing, merge conflict resolution, and pull request collaboration).
skill_recommendations.Programming: Practice core problem solving and code modularity across fundamental computer science paradigms.
skill_recommendations.Data Structures: Practice essential data structures (arrays, linked lists, trees, graphs, heaps, and hash maps) on LeetCode.
skill_recommendations.Algorithms: Master algorithmic problem solving (sorting, binary search, recursion, dynamic programming, and greedy algorithms).
skill_recommendations.OOP: Deepen understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (encapsulation, inheritance, polymorphism, and abstraction design patterns).
skill_recommendations.Database: Learn relational and NoSQL database architecture, schema design, normalization, and indexing strategies.
skill_recommendations.HTML: Master semantic HTML5 markup, modern web accessibility (a11y/WCAG), and search engine optimization basics.
skill_recommendations.CSS: Level up modern CSS design skills (Flexbox, CSS Grid, animations, and responsive styling).
skill_recommendations.JavaScript: Strengthen modern JavaScript concepts (ES6+, closures, promises, async/await, event loop, and DOM manipulation).
skill_recommendations.React: Build interactive single-page applications using React (functional components, Hooks, state management, and component lifecycle).
skill_recommendations.REST API: Learn RESTful API architecture principles, HTTP methods, status codes, authentication, and API documentation.
skill_recommendations.Spring Boot: Learn Spring Boot for enterprise Java backend development, dependency injection, and microservices.
skill_recommendations.Django: Learn Django for Python web development, ORM querying, and secure user authentication.
skill_recommendations.FastAPI: Build high-speed asynchronous REST APIs in Python using FastAPI, Pydantic schemas, and OpenAPI.
skill_recommendations.Node.js: Develop scalable server-side applications using Node.js, middleware, and asynchronous I/O.
skill_recommendations.Responsive Design: Learn mobile-first responsive web design principles, flexible layouts, and CSS media queries.
skill_recommendations.Java: Master core Java principles (Java Collections Framework, multithreading, concurrency, and JVM internals).
